description.zh: Phil（阿哲）的个人网站：前建筑师，现在用 AI 做商业影像、数字人、程序化动效、独立应用和网站，也在这里写提示词美学、AI 工具教程和个人思考。
description.en: Phil's personal site. A former architect who now makes AI films, digital humans, motion graphics, apps and websites, and writes about prompt aesthetics, AI tools and the work behind them.

description.zh: Phil 的博客：拆解设计风格与提示词美学，分享 ComfyUI、Claude、MiniMax 等 AI 工具的上手教程与实践经验，也记录关于表达与职业的个人思考。
description.en: Phil's blog: prompt aesthetics and design-style breakdowns, hands-on tutorials for AI tools such as ComfyUI, Claude and MiniMax, and personal notes on work and expression.

description.zh: 按年份浏览 Phil 发布过的全部文章，涵盖提示词美学、AI 工具教程、实践经验和个人思考，每篇都标注日期、分类与原文发布平台。
description.en: Every article Phil has published, by year: prompt aesthetics, AI tool tutorials, practice notes and personal essays, each with its date, category and original platform.

description.zh: 按主题浏览 Phil 的文章：提示词美学解码、少即是多、提示词分享、AI 知识、AI 实践和个人思考，适合沿着一条线索连续阅读。
description.en: Browse Phil's writing by series: Prompt Aesthetic Decode, Less Is More, prompt sharing, AI knowledge, AI practice and personal notes, to read one thread end to end.
